name: Misfits

tenures.role: tag team — inaugural World Tag Team Champions
tenures.note: The fed's own tag lineage names the team and nothing else; no roster for it survives.

caption: The inaugural World Tag Team Champions, crowned in Osaka Castle Hall in October 1996 and beaten out of a steel cage in Madison Square Garden eight months later.

identity.note: The decorated-aka guard reads the name against misfit. Recorded distinct: a generic team name in an unrelated promotion, with nothing in either record connecting them. A previously-filed note on this row recorded the same reasoning without naming the entity.

notes: Membership resolved 2026-09-06: billed by both names for the first time on the Tuesday Night Catfight of 15 April 1997 (msg_id JoQW41UWKIcJ), managed there by Medusa Rage.

name: Lady Luck

tenures.role: tag team — runner-up in the inaugural World Tag Team title match
tenures.note: The fed's own tag lineage names Lady Luck only as the side the Misfits beat for the inaugural titles. Whether the name belonged to a team or to one wrestler with an unnamed partner is not recoverable from it; filed as a unit because the match it appears in was a tag title match.

caption: The side the Misfits beat in Osaka Castle Hall for the inaugural World Tag Team Championship, named in the fed's own tag lineage and nowhere else in what survives.

identity.note: Shares a name exactly with lady-luck-4ww (4WW), lady-luck-aawc (AAWC) and lady-luck-giwf (GIWF), and is filed distinct from all three: a generic archetype name, a different promotion, and nothing in any of the four records connecting them. The collision doctrine's four signals resolve on the name alone, which is no resolution at all.
